args:
set -euo pipefail
emulator=/home/huawei/commandline-tools-26.0.0.821/bin/Emulator
hdc=/home/huawei/commandline-tools-26.0.0.821/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc
instance_path=/home/huawei/HarmonyOS-Emulator/instances
target=127.0.0.1:10100
launcher=
cleanup() {
  /usr/bin/timeout --kill-after=2s 20s "$emulator" -stop codex_phone_7 -instancePath "$instance_path"
  if [ -n "$launcher" ]; then wait "$launcher" || true; fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
"$emulator" -start codex_phone_7 -instancePath "$instance_path" -imageRoot /home/huawei/HarmonyOS-Emulator/images -bootMode coldboot -noWindow -hdcPort 10100 &
launcher=$!
connected=false
deadline=$((SECONDS + 180))
while [ "$SECONDS" -lt "$deadline" ]; do
  /usr/bin/timeout --kill-after=2s 5s "$hdc" tconn "$target" || true
  if /usr/bin/timeout --kill-after=2s 5s "$hdc" list targets | awk -v target="$target" '$1 == target {found=1} END {exit(!found)}'; then connected=true; break; fi
  sleep 2
done
[ "$connected" = true ]
/usr/bin/timeout --kill-after=2s 10s "$hdc" -t "$target" shell param get const.product.name
/usr/bin/timeout --kill-after=2s 10s "$hdc" -t "$target" shell param get const.ohos.fullname
/usr/bin/timeout --kill-after=2s 10s "$hdc" list targets
